exposure: Gestational weight gain (GWG) below 2009 IOM guidelines
gestational weight gain (GWG) below the IOM guidelines
Gestational weight gain (GWG) within 2009 IOM guidelines
Gestational weight gain (GWG) above 2009 IOM guidelines
cohort: 9301 women with term, singleton, live births at Taipei Chang Gung Memorial Hospital, Taipei, Taiwan between 2009 and 2014
finding: Women with GWG outside the 2009 IOM guidelines were at risk for adverse maternal and neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Women with GWG above the IOM guidelines were at increased risk of primary cesarean delivery due to dysfunctional labor and cephalopelvic disproportion.
